trainers.instruction: Fill in the gaps in the conversation.

atoms.b: Well done, Jacob! You have completed your goal to get at least 8/10 on the spelling test. How would you like to ((++celebrate learn))?
atoms.sound: Well done, Jacob! You have completed your goal to get at least 8 out of 10 on the spelling test. How would you like to celebrate?

atoms.b: Why would I need to celebrate reaching my ((++goal mark))?
atoms.sound: ssml:<prosody pitch = '+1st'>Why would I need to celebrate reaching my goal?</prosody>

atoms.b: Celebrating the achievement of your goals can help you stay ((++motivated bored)) because you recognise all the ((++hard_work tears)) you put into it.
That is true. I feel very ((++proud_of upset_with)) myself because getting that mark wasn’t easy. But I don’t want to celebrate alone.
atoms.sound: ssml:<prosody pitch = '+1st'>That is true. I feel very proud of myself because getting that mark wasn’t easy. But I don’t want to celebrate alone.</prosody>

atoms.b: You don’t have to! ((++Sharing_with Hiding_from)) others is a great way to recognise your accomplishment. Together you can make ((++happy sad)) memories, which make you feel even better about reaching your goal.
Amazing! Now I can’t wait to celebrate and to set a new ((++goal time)) so I can celebrate again.
atoms.sound: ssml:<prosody pitch = '+1st'>Amazing! Now I can’t wait to celebrate and to set a new goal, so I can celebrate again.</prosody>

trainers.instruction: Which option is not a way to celebrate reaching a goal?

feedback.end: Celebrate by treating yourself and sharing with others. Success can inspire new goals and dreams.
After you put a lot of work into achieving your goal, taking a break can help you recharge. Creating a certificate can help you remember your achievement.
While you might not have achieved everything you want yet, it is important to recognise what you <u>have</u> accomplished. You can do this by taking a picture or doing something you enjoy.
